incident.title: Personalized Incident Response
incident.description: Select your exact situation below for immediate official response steps and reporting channels.
incident.notSentDescription: I received the message or scheme offer but have not transferred any money.
incident.sentMoneyDescription: I have transferred funds or made a payment.
incident.installedApp: I installed an app / opened a link
incident.installedAppDescription: I interacted with an APK, app, or suspicious web link.
incident.notSentStep1: Do not send money, OTPs, passwords, or account credentials.
incident.notSentStep2: Verify the sender and organization using an independent official source.
incident.notSentStep3: Avoid installing apps or opening links until independently verified.
incident.sentMoneyTitle: Act quickly to report & preserve evidence
incident.sentMoneyStep1: Contact your bank or payment provider immediately through its official channel.
incident.sentMoneyStep2: Preserve transaction details, chat logs, UPI IDs, and evidence.
incident.sentMoneyStep3: Report suspected cyber financial fraud through the official cybercrime reporting portal.
incident.installedAppStep1: Do not enter passwords, OTPs, or banking credentials into the app or website.
incident.installedAppStep2: Avoid granting additional permissions to untrusted apps.
incident.installedAppStep3: If sensitive information was entered, contact your bank/service provider immediately.
incident.installedAppStep4: Report financial loss or cybercrime to the official Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.
incident.goldenHourNote: Note: Rapid reporting within 1-2 hours ('Golden Hour') increases the chance of freezing funds in destination bank accounts.
incident.reportDeviceCompromise: Report Device Compromise to Cyber Crime →
